name: Weak-day long after a gap up
why: A weak close forces de-risking (vol-targeting funds, margin, stops); dealers and dip buyers absorb it and the next session mean-reverts, most in fearful (high VIX) regimes where forced selling overshoots. A panic gap down extends the forced selling. Pre-registered research/preregistered/2026-10-16_round3.md.
